Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Trigger device logs > 'Device Logs 2' - 'Device Log info'. Steps (hidden behind a HYPERLINK formula in the cell, confirmed by reading the raw formula rather than the rendered text): follow https://www.commcarehq.org/admin/ota/devicelogrequest/add/, fill Domain=qateam/Username=test1, Save. Verified live 2026-08-27: created a real DeviceLogRequest row, confirmed present on the changelist afterward (domain=qateam, username=test1, timestamped the same run).

Run via `python scripts/hq_client.py hq_setup/trigger_device_logs/device_logs_2_request.json` before Device Logs 3 ('Trigger') - that row logs back into the app and syncs, which is what causes the device to actually respond to this pending request.
